# Reasoning-step sweep (SequentialReason, BM25 and e5) (generated by experiments/_shared/summarize.py)

SequentialReason with 2, 3, 5 and 8 steps and the one-call NaiveReason baseline, k = 20, BM25 and e5, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ on a Colab T4, greedy, slice `s306.json` (306 questions, 34 per hop, all 12 users; a subset of the 900-question slice). One call = tag `s1` (k = 20) restricted to these questions; 5 steps = committed session-2 run (tag `s2`); 2, 3 and 8 steps = tag `s3_steps`. Intervals: 95% bootstrap over questions (2000 resamples); paired differences use a paired bootstrap on the same questions. Leak-free = questions sharing no number with their gold statements (any-number rule).
